description.value: This study investigated whether apolipoprotein ε4 allele carrier status has disease-specific effects on gray matter atrophy in patients with probable Alzheimer's disease and behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia using voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: In this study, we performed a clinical and voxel-based morphometry (VBM) analysis to investigate the influence of apoE ε4 allele carrier status on disease severity and gray matter (GM) atrophy in a large cohort of patients with probable AD and bvFTD at presentation.

description.value: The study was a cross-sectional comparison of patients with probable AD and bvFTD and healthy controls at presentation.

model_settings.value: Voxel-based morphometry using SPM5 unified segmentation; images normalized, segmented, Jacobian-modulated, cleaned up, and smoothed with a 12-mm FWHM isotropic Gaussian kernel. Age, gender, CDR box score, and total intracranial volume were entered as nuisance variables; Gaussian random-field theory was used for inference.
